🔌 LogicGate

Logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND) are the building blocks of computers. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Each gate has a specific logic function — learn AND, OR, NOT, XOR rules.
  2. Connect inputs through gates to produce the target output.
  3. Some puzzles require chaining multiple gates together.
  4. Check your circuit against the truth table to verify correctness.
  5. Start simple and build up to more complex gate networks.
